title: OpenXiangda 2.75.9: organization-scoped third-party cards
summary: Generic event contracts retain application-owned content and targets while the platform resolves enterprise authorization and class recipients.
newFeatures: Declared class-role notification audiences and verified related delivery organizations.
Managed configuration for third-party card channels and custom content/link parameter names.
Explicit read-only organization_id metadata for event workers; no wider row authority.
affectedUsers: V2 application developers sending cards through third-party school installations.

compatibility.platform: Requires matching notification platform services and compiler.

upgradeSteps: Upgrade the matching backend and configure published templates with encrypted credential references.
Pin the SDK, verify organization isolation and detail permissions on TEST, then promote.
knownLimitations: Package tests do not prove real DingTalk receipt, placeholder substitution or login return.
No automatic historical resend; recover uncertain results with original keys.
